label: prop:colour-braid-commuting-singlet
title: A linear map commuting with the colour braiding keeps the singlet line
html: Let K be a field and q \in K^\times with q^2 + 1 \neq 0. Let \check R_{12}, \check R_{23} be Jimbo's braidings on (K^3)^{\otimes 3}, and let \Phi be a K-linear map of (K^3)^{\otimes 3} with \Phi \check R_{12} = \check R_{12} \Phi and \Phi \check R_{23} = \check R_{23} \Phi. Then \Phi(\varepsilon_q) is a scalar multiple of \varepsilon_q. In particular, if the colour swap s of the colour-relabel proposition commuted with both braidings, then q^2 = 1.
heading: Proposition
